title: euphrasia officinalis subsp. salisburgensis
intro: Euphrasia officinalis subsp. salisburgensis, commonly known as Austrian eye-parsley, is a subspecies of the Euphrasia officinalis plant, a type of flowering plant in the family Scrophulariaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to support eye health and alleviate symptoms of dry, irritated eyes. The therapeutic actions of Austrian eye-parsley include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe and protect the eyes. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoid glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
